title: The orb gets a page

items: Nothing has been checked on a real phone yet.

intro.narration: Session recap. The orb gets a page.

goal.narration: I asked Claude to put the thinking orb on my site, under experiments. And make a 15-second reel. Go all out.

stats.narration: About 10 minutes and 53 steps later, it was done. One commit, 14 files.

device.narration: The reel is drawn frame by frame by the real orb engine. Nothing in it is a mock-up.

browser.narration: It got its own page: the reel up top, a playground you can grab, and all nine states.

notes: Hold one: the playground, every setting

timeline.narration: Then it sat. 8 days later I went looking on quietbands.com, and it wasn't there. The work was done. It just never got merged.

merge.narration: So we merged it. And Claude owned a mistake on the way in: a 2.6 megabyte sound file that should never have been committed. Pull request 23 took it out.

beforeafter.narration: Before, the R&D page stopped at Lab 001. Now Lab 002 sits on top, with a live orb.

checklist.narration: 65 of 65 tests passing. Captions written for four platforms. Two things are still on me: the live site, and a real phone.
